body_md:
These five Orlando-area HVAC businesses each have a Florida Certified Air Conditioning Contractor license listed as Current, Active, with a named owner on the license record. License details come from a state licensing board lookup, and every license shown expires on 08/31/2028. Four of the companies describe themselves as family-owned.

## How we picked

Each listing was checked against a state licensing board lookup for license number, status, licensee name, licensed business name, license address, original date, and expiration date. Those facts link to the state license detail page for that contractor. Service area, hours, years in business, and service features appear only when they were included with the listing. Fields marked unknown were left unknown.

## At a glance

- All five licenses are Current, Active, and expire on 08/31/2028: CAC1818233 (AC's Heating & Air LLC), CAC1817519 (Downtown Air and Heat LLC), CAC1820978 (Kinkos Air LLC), CAC1815904 (Duncan's Air Conditioning & Heating), and CAC1814337 (Gary Munson Heating & A/C Service, Inc.).
- Original license dates are 01/03/2005 for Gary Munson Heating & A/C Service, Inc., 07/01/2008 for Duncan's Air Conditioning & Heating, 06/20/2013 for Downtown Air and Heat LLC, 06/09/2015 for AC's Heating & Air LLC, and 06/24/2021 for Kinkos Air LLC.
- Stated company history is separate from those license dates: Gary Munson Heating & A/C Service, Inc. lists since 1978, Duncan's Air Conditioning & Heating lists since 2008, AC's Heating & Air LLC lists a 2011 start, and Kinkos Air LLC states over two decades of experience on its company site. Years in business for Downtown Air and Heat LLC are unknown.
- Listed service areas are Orange County for AC's Heating & Air LLC (Apopka); the greater Orlando area and Central Florida for Downtown Air and Heat LLC; the Orlando metropolitan area from Casselberry and Oviedo to St. Cloud and Maitland for Kinkos Air LLC; Orlando and surrounding areas, including Winter Park and Winter Garden, for Duncan's Air Conditioning & Heating; and the Orlando, FL area for Gary Munson Heating & A/C Service, Inc.

## Things to know before you go

License addresses on file are 3135 Hunter Place, Apopka, Florida 32703; 311 E Jersey Street, Orlando, Florida 32806; 1150 N Dean Rd, Orlando, Florida 32825; 2251 Lynx Lane, Suite 1, Orlando, Florida 32804; and 1215 Stevens Ave, Orlando, Florida 32806, in the same company order as above. The Duncan's Air Conditioning & Heating license is issued to DUNCAN MECHANICAL SERVICES INC. Licensee names are Allen Hayne Chennault, Shawn Paul Hoskins, Juan C Suescun, Mark Anthony Duncan, and Gary Eugene Munson. Owners named are Allen Chennault, Shawn Hoskins, Juan Suescun Rozo, Mark Duncan, and Gary Munson. The Duncan's listing also says the company was opened by Mark Duncan and his wife Rachel.

Hours are listed for two companies. Downtown Air and Heat LLC is Monday through Saturday, 8am–5pm, with emergency service available. Kinkos Air LLC is Monday–Friday 8:00 am–5:00 pm, Saturday 8:00 am–1:00 pm, and closed Sunday; the listed phone is 407-725-4900. Hours were not included for AC's Heating & Air LLC, Duncan's Air Conditioning & Heating, or Gary Munson Heating & A/C Service, Inc.

Each company lists residential heating and air conditioning plus a commercial or light-commercial scope. AC's Heating & Air LLC also lists heat pumps, ductwork, insulation, and indoor air quality. Downtown Air and Heat LLC also lists indoor air quality, custom ductwork, NATE-certified technicians, a 1-year work guarantee, and payment by cash, checks, Visa, MasterCard, Discover, and American Express. Kinkos Air LLC also lists installations, maintenance, duct installation and cleaning, bilingual English and Spanish service, and financing. Duncan's Air Conditioning & Heating lists Trane Comfort Specialist. Gary Munson Heating & A/C Service, Inc. also lists indoor air quality, commercial refrigeration, and extended equipment warranties. Downtown Air and Heat LLC, Kinkos Air LLC, Duncan's Air Conditioning & Heating, and Gary Munson Heating & A/C Service, Inc. describe themselves as family-owned.

## FAQ

### Are these HVAC licenses current?

On the state licensing board lookup used here, each status is Current, Active, and each expiration date shown is 08/31/2028. Use the linked license detail to recheck the record before you hire.

### Which listing matches my part of the Orlando area?

AC's Heating & Air LLC lists Orange County. Downtown Air and Heat LLC lists the greater Orlando area and Central Florida. Kinkos Air LLC names Casselberry, Oviedo, St. Cloud, and Maitland. Duncan's Air Conditioning & Heating names Winter Park and Winter Garden among surrounding areas. Gary Munson Heating & A/C Service, Inc. lists the Orlando, FL area. If your city is not named, ask whether that company covers your address.

### What was not included, so I should ask?

Hours were not included for AC's Heating & Air LLC, Duncan's Air Conditioning & Heating, or Gary Munson Heating & A/C Service, Inc. Years in business were not included for Downtown Air and Heat LLC. Payment types are listed only for Downtown Air and Heat LLC, financing only for Kinkos Air LLC, and a phone number only for Kinkos Air LLC (407-725-4900). Confirm the work you need, scheduling, and how you will pay with the company you contact.
